description: a plugin designed to enhance player interaction and visibility by automatically assigning a glowing effect to players upon joining the server. Each player is given a unique color based on the order in which they connect, making it easy to identify individuals in a group or event.

mods.name: GlowPlayers
mods.description: Server-side mod: every player glows in their own color and the Locator Bar waypoint matches. Configurable in game through a chest GUI.
